import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import xgboost as xgb

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
os.environ["MKL_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
xgb.XGBClassifier().verbosity = 0
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)

# Set paths based on benchmark instructions
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
sample_sub_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
sub_output_path = "./submission/submission.csv"

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)

# Identify Species Columns from Sample Submission (excluding 'id')
specie_cols = sorted([c for c in sample_sub.columns if c != "id"])

print(f"Number of species columns: {len(specie_cols)}")
print(f"Training set shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test set shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Get all feature columns (all numeric columns except id and species in train, id in test)
feature_names = [col for col in test_df.columns if col != "id"]

print(f"Using {len(feature_names)} features")

# Prepare Features - extract feature columns only
X_train = train_df[feature_names].astype(np.float64).values
X_test = test_df[feature_names].astype(np.float64).values

# Encode Species Labels Properly
le = LabelEncoder()
y_train_original = train_df["species"].tolist()
y_train_encoded = le.fit_transform(y_train_original)

# Split into Train + Holdout Validation (NOT refit on validation set later)
X_train_final, X_holdout, y_train_enc, y_holdout_enc = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train_encoded, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_encoded
)

print(f"Training set size: {len(X_train_final)}, Holdout set size: {len(X_holdout)}")

# Build Model - Increased n_estimators from 2000 to 5000 for better convergence
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=5000,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=1.0,
    verbosity=0,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=1,
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
)

# Fit Model
model.fit(
    X_train_final,
    y_train_enc,
    verbose=False,
)

# Generate Predictions for Test AND Holdout Sets
test_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)
holdout_proba = model.predict_proba(X_holdout)

# Convert validation encoded labels to one-hot format for consistent evaluation
classes = np.unique(le.classes_)
class_map = {cls: idx for idx, cls in enumerate(classes)}
valid_labels_one_hot = np.zeros((len(y_holdout_enc), len(classes)))
for i, label_idx in enumerate(y_holdout_enc):
    valid_labels_one_hot[i, label_idx] = 1.0


# Compute Multi-Class Log Loss Function (official metric as defined in Task Description)
def compute_multiclass_logloss(true_labels_one_hot, pred_probs):
    epsilon = 1e-15
    p_safe = np.clip(pred_probs, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)

    total_error = 0.0
    for i in range(len(pred_probs)):
        true_col_idx = int(np.where(true_labels_one_hot[i] == 1)[0][0])
        total_error += np.log(p_safe[i, true_col_idx])

    return -total_error / len(pred_probs)


# Compute Hold-Out Validation Log Loss Metric (score on held-out data ONLY)
val_logloss = compute_multiclass_logloss(valid_labels_one_hot, holdout_proba)
print(f"Hold-Out Validation Multi-Class Log-Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Clip test predictions for safe submission as per instructions
test_proba_clipped = np.clip(test_proba, 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15)

# Create submission DataFrame matching sample submission format
sub_df = pd.DataFrame(index=test_df["id"].values, columns=specie_cols)
for i, col_name in enumerate(specie_cols):
    sub_df[col_name] = test_proba_clipped[:, i]

# Save submission file at required path
sub_df.to_csv(sub_output_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {sub_output_path}")
print(f"Hold-Out Validation Multi-Class Log-Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")
